description: The bar chart titled “Average Entropy Across Sycophancy Reduction Methods on Static Experiments” illustrates the entropy average values for three different AI models—GPT-4, Claude, and Llama—under three sycophancy reduction methods: Baseline (pink), Source Info (yellow), and Direct Command (light blue), as indicated by the legend in the upper right. The vertical y-axis, labeled “Entropy Average Values,” ranges from 3.0 to 6.0 in increments of 0.5, representing the average entropy metric. The horizontal x-axis, labeled “Different AI Models,” displays the three models in left-to-right order: GPT-4, Claude, and Llama. For each model, three adjacent bars show the entropy under each method. GPT-4 exhibits entropy values of approximately 4.9 (Baseline), 5.2 (Source Info), and 5.0 (Direct Command). Claude shows values of roughly 4.7 (Baseline), 5.1 (Source Info), and 4.9 (Direct Command). Llama has entropy values around 4.5 (Baseline), 4.9 (Source Info), and 4.8 (Direct Command). Across all models, the “Source Info” method consistently yields the highest entropy, followed by “Direct Command,” with “Baseline” showing the lowest entropy values. The bars are grouped by model and are not sorted by height, with no additional annotations or emphasis beyond color coding.
